Vendored Tree-sitter runtime + generated grammars (syntax highlighting
for the sketerm editor pane). All GPL-3-compatible permissive licenses.

Everything here is GENERATED or hand-written C — no node/JS toolchain is
needed at build time. `zig build` compiles these sources into the GUI
targets only (see `addTreeSitter` in build.zig). They must NEVER enter
the `sketerm-mux` / `mux-portable` dependency graph.

runtime
  github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter @ 97e2eeb83cdd6d78d7a614318abf9dead59acace (2026-08-04)
  MIT (LICENSE) — lib/include/tree_sitter/api.h + lib/src/**
  lib/src/lib.c is the upstream amalgamation (#includes every other .c).
  lib/src/wasm/ was dropped: wasm_store.c compiles to stubs without
  TREE_SITTER_FEATURE_WASM, which we never define.
  lib/src/unicode/ is ICU-derived (lib/src/unicode/LICENSE, permissive).

grammars/zig
  github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-zig @ 6479aa13f32f701c383083d8b28360ebd682fb7d (2025-09-10)
  MIT — src/parser.c (LANGUAGE_VERSION 15), src/tree_sitter/*.h
grammars/c
  github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-c @ b780e47fc780ddc8da13afa35a3f4ed5c157823d (2026-04-22)
  MIT — src/parser.c (LANGUAGE_VERSION 15), src/tree_sitter/*.h
grammars/json
  github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-json @ 001c28d7a29832b06b0e831ec77845553c89b56d (2025-09-14)
  MIT — src/parser.c (LANGUAGE_VERSION 14), src/tree_sitter/*.h
grammars/markdown, grammars/markdown_inline
  github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-markdown @ a0a00f817d02412bd92c54d316f164d827b57b5c (2026-07-19)
  MIT — src/parser.c + src/scanner.c (LANGUAGE_VERSION 15), src/tree_sitter/*.h

Each grammar keeps ITS OWN src/tree_sitter/ headers rather than sharing
one copy: those headers pin the language ABI the generated table was
emitted against (json is v14, the rest v15), and the runtime accepts
anything in [TREE_SITTER_MIN_COMPATIBLE_LANGUAGE_VERSION 13, 15].

queries/*.scm
  Upstream `queries/highlights.scm` of the same commits, renamed per
  language and embedded into the binary by build.zig. Capture names are
  the nvim-flavoured convention; src/editor/syntax.zig maps them onto a
  small fixed palette of highlight kinds.
